object_description: staggered main volume with a smaller prismatic annex
design_condition: Two volumes occupy both plots, with the main building stepping toward the viaduct and following the track field, while excavation creates a generous low-level outdoor space linked by a boulevard and campus square.

positive.statement: The proposal creates a clear and simple campus structure with functioning logistics processes.

position.rationale: Distributed marker covers the connected stepped building arrangement supporting campus-wide logistics.

positive.statement: The central passage is formulated as a meeting space and connects public uses along the length of the building.

position.rationale: Top view indicates a longitudinal central void or passage through the main volume.

positive.statement: Connecting the campus at city level to surrounding pedestrian routes and public spaces is convincing.

position.target: surrounding pedestrian routes and public spaces
position.rationale: Site-level marker is placed along the building perimeter where routes and public spaces connect.

positive.statement: The robust structural approach is overlaid by an interior opening with great identification potential.

position.rationale: Central opening is identifiable in plan and reflected by the surrounding elevations.

positive.statement: The buildings are designed flexibly for changes in use and to carry on the history of the place through their shape.

position.rationale: Stepped and connected volumes provide the visible massing anchor for adaptable use and place identity.

negative.statement: The landscape themes are almost exclusively confined to the north-facing area and therefore seem added together.

position.rationale: North-side site edge is constrained by the directional comment and perimeter geometry.

negative.statement: The required route along the city stream is on the wrong side, and the infrastructure buildings are insufficiently integrated.

position.rationale: A perimeter route is approximated at the lower site edge; the stream itself is not distinguishable.

negative.statement: The passerelle is too narrow, too steep, and partly outside the perimeter.

position.rationale: Potential connector is placed near the central link, with slope and perimeter status unresolved.

negative.statement: Some courtyards are too narrow, so insufficient daylight reaches the rooms everywhere.

position.rationale: Several enclosed voids are visible in plan and correspond to daylight-limited adjacent rooms.

negative.statement: The central passage is diminished by a second boulevard running parallel to it.

position.target: second boulevard parallel to the central passage
position.rationale: Parallel circulation is approximated beside the central longitudinal passage in the main footprint.

negative.statement: The supports conflict with individual rooms and the structural system is complex and rigid.

position.rationale: Colonnaded structural traces are visible, while their conflicts with interior rooms remain approximate.

negative.statement: The large building volume and envelope area make the project the most expensive of the ranked proposals.

position.rationale: The broad stepped mass and extensive envelope are directly visible across all calibrated views.
